research_question: Does the value surprise of the actual starting XI relative to the club's recent strictly-prior complete lineups, including defensive-versus-offensive unit balance, add stable draw-probability information beyond market, R39L and R39N?

zero_label_source_audit.selection_rationale: Use a five-lineup baseline because the hypothesis is match-specific lineup surprise rather than long-run club strength. Require at least nine valued starters because this preserves the complete target identity lane for current XI valuation and preserves fixed100 100/100 for the five-lineup baseline. Window 3 loses two fixed100 identities; threshold 11 loses seven; window 10 is less recent without a material blind-coverage advantage over window 5 at threshold 9.

zero_label_schema_amendment.reason: The source audit showed Transfermarkt target rows use specific position strings such as Centre-Back and Centre-Forward rather than generic Defender/Attack labels. The audit-only substring mapper therefore classified these as OTHER. No target outcomes were accessed.
zero_label_schema_amendment.unknown_position_policy: feature-ineligible; never impute or silently map

blind_binding.origin: pre-existing R39I fixed100 locked before R39O hypothesis

point_in_time_contract.actual_XI: target-match starting lineup identity is allowed as pre-match information; target-match performance is forbidden
point_in_time_contract.prior_lineups: last five complete club starting lineups with game_date strictly before target_date across available competitions
point_in_time_contract.valuation_rule: for every player identity, latest positive finite market_value_in_eur with valuation_date strictly before target_date
point_in_time_contract.baseline_valuation_time: prior lineup player identities are revalued using only valuations observable strictly before the TARGET date, isolating lineup-composition surprise from historical valuation drift

lineup_metrics.total_log_value: log1p(sum of valued starter market values)
lineup_metrics.recent_baseline: componentwise median across the valid lineups among the last five strictly-prior complete lineups

feature_contract.reason: Absolute XI value was already tested in R39N; R39O isolates match-specific deviation from recent lineup composition.

rolling_design.candidate_selection: lowest pooled HDA_LogLoss, then pooled binary_Draw_LogLoss, then larger L2

execution_gate.next_required_asset: one complete zero-label hash-locked R39O feature snapshot; live Transfermarkt recomputation forbidden during evaluation
